os: ubuntu-24.04 (x86-64). Upstream release.yml builds Linux on runner ubuntu-24.04; build.yml PR/main Linux jobs use a self-hosted runner [self-hosted, linux, x64, anyps5] whose distro is not stated; sanitizers.yml uses ubuntu-latest. Write-watch tests need Linux kernel >= 6.7 (UFFD_FEATURE_WP_ASYNC), which is a property of the Docker HOST kernel, not the image.
compiler: GCC/G++ with C++20 (CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20); CI passes -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++ with ccache as launcher. GCC version on Linux not pinned in fetched files (unknown). Clang only for the optional relinker fuzzers (libclang-rt-18-dev on Ubuntu 24.04).
cmake: >= 3.22.1 for the full build with bundled dependencies (BUILD.md); CMakeLists.txt declares cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20); generator Ninja.
configure_command: git submodule update --init --recursive && cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++ -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache
notes: Configure downloads FFmpeg binaries unless -DFFMPEG_PREBUILT_DIR=<path> is set (BUILD.md line 77). That conflicts with a no-downloaded-binaries policy; how to build the FFmpeg package from source was not found in the files read (unknown).
Relinker-only build, no submodules or GPU needed: cmake -S . -B build-relinker -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DANYPS5_RELINKER_ONLY=ON -DBUILD_TESTING=ON (BUILD.md line 8).
At least one of libpipewire-0.3-dev / libpulse-dev / libasound2-dev is required, otherwise configure fails (BUILD.md line 72).

Optional -DANYPS5_USE_SYSTEM_DEPS=ON needs libsdl2-dev (real SDL2 with HIDAPI, not sdl2-compat), libfreetype-dev (>= 2.15 per cmake/SystemDeps.cmake), libvulkan-dev, spirv-headers, glslang-dev, glslang-tools, spirv-tools; Vulkan-Headers >= 1.4.330.
GPU tests in CI run on Mesa lavapipe (mesa-vulkan-drivers). Validation layer >= 1.4.335 is required for VUID runs (BUILD.md).
Linux shared-memory import uses /dev/udmabuf; without access, four native depth tests fail instead of skipping (issue #23709). In Docker, pass the device or expect those failures.
The 'locales' package is listed in BUILD.md for the HTTP locale test; the exact locale to generate was not checked (unknown).
Fedora only: glibc-static and libstdc++-static if CMake reports 'Could NOT find Threads' (static linking is enabled).
